input.prompt: Medium tracking shot at night: she runs away through the tall grass, glances back over her left shoulder toward the camera with wide alert eyes, then turns forward again and keeps running; hair flying; white flashlight beams flare across the grass behind her. The camera tracks with her. Anime style, consistent with the first frame, clean cel shading, same character design: same face, same large eyes (same size, never smaller), same long straight black hair, same white cropped jacket with orange bands and patches, black top and trousers; no glasses. Smooth, stable lineart, no morphing, correct hands with five fingers. Single continuous shot, no cuts. No text, no subtitles, no logos.
